name: Colossal Fighter/Assault Mode
extDescription: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with Assault Mode Activate. When this card is Special Summoned, you can send up to 2 Warrior-type monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard. All monsters your opponent controls lose 100 ATK for every Warrior-type monster in your Graveyard. When this card on the field is destroyed, you can Special Summon 1 Colossal Fighter from your Graveyard.
